title: GAIA Controller Input
description: Schema for the input request to the GAIA Agentic Controller.

images.description: One or more satellite images supplied with the request.

reference.description: The identity or URI reference to the uploaded image.

format.description: The format of the image (e.g., tiff, jpeg, png).

modality.description: The imaging modality when known (e.g., optical, SAR).

acquisition_time.description: The acquisition time of the image when known.

spatial_metadata.description: Spatial and reference metadata when available.

is_pair.description: Whether the input is intended to represent a pair (e.g., for bi-temporal or cross-modal analysis).
